# truefoundry_guardrail_group (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry AI Gateway guardrail config group and its guardrails. Applied as a `provider-account/guardrail-config-group` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Existing groups can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_guardrail_group.example my-tenant:guardrail-config-group:my-group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A guardrail group with Azure Prompt Shield and Content Safety,
# keys referenced from Vault.
resource "truefoundry_guardrail_group" "region" {
  name = "guardrails-francecentral"

  collaborators = [
    {
      subject = "user:jane@example.com"
      role_id = "provider-account-manager"
    },
  ]

  guardrails = [
    {
      type               = "azure-prompt-shield"
      name               = "ps-francecentral"
      description        = "Jailbreak and prompt injection detection"
      api_key            = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::contentsafety/francecentral/value"
      enforcing_strategy = "enforce_but_ignore_on_error"
      resource_name      = "cog-guardrails-francecentral"
      api_version        = "2024-09-01"
    },
    {
      type               = "azure-content-safety"
      name               = "cs-francecentral"
      description        = "Hate, self-harm, sexual, and violence detection"
      api_key            = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::contentsafety/francecentral/value"
      enforcing_strategy = "enforce_but_ignore_on_error"
      resource_name      = "cog-guardrails-francecentral"
      api_version        = "2024-09-01"
      severity_threshold = 4
      categories         = ["Hate", "SelfHarm", "Sexual", "Violence"]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `guardrails` (Attributes List) Guardrail configs in this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrails))
- `name` (String) Name of the guardrail config group (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `collaborators` (Attributes List) Subjects with a role on this guardrail config group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the guardrail config group.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the guardrail config group.

<a id="nestedatt--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrails`

Required:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the Azure Content Safety resource. Accepts a TrueFoundry secret reference (recommended — keeps secret material out of the Terraform state); the control plane returns the value as stored, so drift is detected.
- `api_version` (String) Azure API version, e.g. 2024-09-01.
- `enforcing_strategy` (String) How violations are handled. One of: `enforce`, `enforce_but_ignore_on_error`, `audit`. `enforce` blocks on failure and on guardrail errors, `enforce_but_ignore_on_error` blocks on failure but continues on guardrail errors, `audit` only records violations.
- `name` (String) Name identifying this guardrail config.
- `resource_name` (String) Name of the Azure Content Safety resource the service is deployed on, e.g. my-content-safety.
- `type` (String) Guardrail type. One of: `azure-prompt-shield`, `azure-content-safety`.

Optional:

- `blocklist_names` (List of String) Custom Azure Content Safety blocklists to check text against (`azure-content-safety` only).
- `categories` (List of String) Harm categories to detect. One or more of: `Hate`, `SelfHarm`, `Sexual`, `Violence`. Required for `azure-content-safety`, must be unset for `azure-prompt-shield`.
- `custom_host` (String) Custom endpoint URL; unset uses the default Azure endpoint.
- `description` (String) Optional description of this guardrail config.
- `severity_threshold` (Number) Minimum severity (0-6) to flag content; lower blocks more. Required for `azure-content-safety`, must be unset for `azure-prompt-shield`.


<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. provider-account-manager.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:my-team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Guardrail groups are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:guardrail-config-group:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_guardrail_group.region my-tenant:guardrail-config-group:guardrails-francecentral
```
